author: zicuri
body:
Age: I'm 17 yearls old
Timezone: UTC-4
Do you have access to TeamSpeak? Yes/No: Yes
Do you have access to Skype? Yes/No: Yes
Do you have access to a recording software? Yes/No: Yes

CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION

Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers?

I used to be a moderator in HCF servers like parapvp and a no premium one, I also was a translator for like a month in kohi. (I was not very active so my position there ended quickly)

What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating? What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating?

In my opinion, my biggest weakness is my character, sometimes I disagree with someone and I start an argument and some people find it annoying.

How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team?

I would help the staff team with my activity and opinions about the server, I consider myself as a honest person and hard worker when something gets to me and nowadays I have been interested in avicus more than other Minecraft server.

What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Do you consider yourself to be a leader? Why?

In my opinion a leader must be coherent with his words, think fast and focus in important things, I do consider myself as a leader because I have the experience with that position,  in my work and in another games I have been leader of groups and students for long time.

What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?

I don't think a moderator has to be special or differente to others, I consider a moderator as a person who likes to do the rights things, a person who has time for it and want to improve the server with activity and good vibes to others and of course maturity.

What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?

When you interact with the community you have to make them feel that you hear their opinions and make them to happen, also be a friendly and sweet person to others always help because they will atleast not be mad at you. If I have to tell you of course I have these skills but I'm not sure about it, some people say that I am friendly and a people person but others disagree.

How much time can you commit to being a staff member (Rough Idea)? 
 
I have too much leisure time, I can give to the server around 10am to 6pm in my time obviously with rest in between, I work all nights from 6:30pm to 10:00 pm and monday's, wednesday's and friday's from 7:00 am to 9:00 am, It can vary if I have social meetings.

CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS

You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly ban evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do?

Well, I would start by freezing him because it is the only thing that I can do as a trial, then I would try to contact a moderator, sr moderator, developer or an admin in the medias of the staff and have the important things recorded.

Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on Teamspeak in their team channel. The staff member is also referee and has physical permissions to be in that channel. However the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked him to leave multiple times. What would you do?

I would start by recording the staff member doing that for a hopefully future demotion, then I would try to talk with the staff member in order to get him calm down until a bigger staff comes to the room.

A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realise that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore there is no physical evidence. You know however this person did indeed break the rules, what would you do?

I would respond the appeal by saying that I am very sure that he broke the rules but regrettably the evidence is corrupted, I am letting this guy have the infraction because I'm sure of what he did.

You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confident but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do?

I am going to be honest in this situation, leak information to a friend that is not going to send it in others group chats, I won't report the staff member of my team I would say please don't leak information again or I will get it to the seniors, I don't like people who leaks information but if the content of the screenshot is not very important I would give a vocal warn first.

One day the Senior Staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of the decision or the circumstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However you do not like the decision based from what you know. What would you do?

First, I would try to get the positive side of the decision, get more information and finally obey to the decision.

CRITERIA 3: OTHER

What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you?

More work, less leisure time and responsability that I want for me it is bad to have too much leisure time.

How passionate are you about Avicus? What does Avicus mean to you?

Avicus is a server that does a hard effort to stay alive and that is something that I really admire, Avicus for me means a destroy community that need help and people who cares about the server the regulars here attack the staff and the server that is something bad, basically I appreciate avicus for the long time its online.

Do you speak any other languages than English?

Yes, I do it is spanish.

Do you have anything else to add to your application?

Well, I tried to give my honest reasons because that is how I work, If you dont know me as a person you should try right away, I hope to start working with you guys and improve the server.

Regards.

replies.body:
[Denied] - I am sorry to say your application has been denied.

Here are the reasons why:

- Overall Behavior on the network needs to improve. We suggest that if you are interested in becoming Mod, you need to improve your behavior and attitude on all Avicus platforms.

You may not submit another application.
